snippet.title: Calm History Tales
snippet.description:
Welcome to Calm History Tales, a channel dedicated to relaxing, soft-spoken storytelling about the past.

Here, history is told slowly and gently — perfect for
• falling asleep
• unwinding after a long day
• studying or working with background sound
• peaceful long-form listening

Each episode explores the everyday lives, cultures, struggles, and forgotten details of different periods in history — all narrated in a calm, soothing voice designed to help you relax.

If you love history but prefer a peaceful listening experience, this is your quiet corner of the internet.

Let the soft echoes of the past accompany your nights.

snippet.description:

Each episode is a long-form audio journey through history: medieval villages, ancient palaces, strange customs, and forgotten lives. No lectures, no stress—just calm storytelling, light humor, and facts that make you smile before you sleep.
Perfect for bedtime listening, relaxing, or falling asleep to. New podcast episodes weekly. Subscribe and let history carry you to dreamland.

This channel explores how people lived their daily lives in the 1800s and early 1900s.

If you enjoy historical stories, old world documentaries, and life before electricity, make sure to subscribe and explore the past with us.

snippet.title: sew_through_time
snippet.description: Hi! I'm Maria, a historical costumer and sewist with a passion for recreating historical silhouettes. My main focus is the 18th century to Edwardian fashion and most of my content is from those eras. I have some professional training in modern clothing construction but most of my skills are from a lifetime of sewing, knitting and other crafts. I started historical costuming in 2019 and have been ever since deep diving especially into 18th century construction and technique. Most of what I do I try to stay faithful to historic technique but I do occasionally make things faster but I try my best to always do my homework and keep it a conscious decision when I deviate from historical accuracy.
